title: Scout C-A: packet composition per role (token entry points, repeated sections, exposed tools, loaded instructions)
spec: Objective: give the Planner, with path:line anchors, what each role's model invocation receives today and what is repeated across roles for the same task. Read (this checkout, main): orchestrator/spawn.py packet()/_packet_body (lines 181-410: sources, memory recall, gotchas, repomap, spec/acceptance/scope, base sha), _role_packet (391), review_packet (412-493), spec_review_packet (494-512), scout_packet (513-570), render() and .orchestrator/prompts/*.md (execute.md, fix-round.md, fix-delta.md, review.md, spec-review.md, scout.md, challenge.md, planner.md, planner-decision.md, planner-shadow.md; sizes 257-4307 bytes), run_claude (571-) for the appended system prompt, --allowedTools and MCP config each role gets (.mcp.worker.json, .mcp.planner.json, .mcp.json), orchestrator/executor.py for the Codex packet and resume/fix-delta packet, orchestrator/daemon.py _fix_round_spec and _dispatch_fresh_fix, orchestrator/planner_packet.py and orchestrator/planner_runs.py (headless Planner prompt, escalation/handover packets), orchestrator/handover.py. Deliver: 1. a table role × section (system prompt/instructions, task spec, acceptance, scope, memory recall, gotchas, repomap, diff, gate output, prior result, tool definitions) with approximate tokens (chars/4) per section for a typical task, citing the code that assembles each section; 2. sections that are byte-identical across roles for one task (spec, acceptance, memory, gotchas, diff) with anchors: the amplification P1 must measure; 3. tools and MCP schemas each role always receives (names, approximate schema tokens) and which are never used by that role; 4. instructions always loaded regardless of task (per prompt file and CLAUDE.md), with the conditional candidates P12 could split out; 5. where a handoff rebuilds context from scratch (Planner escalation, fresh fix round, Codex fresh vs resume). Rules: read-only; cite path:line; confidence 0-1 per finding; result under 1,500 tokens; say unverifiable rather than guess.
acceptance: result under 1,500 tokens with findings anchored path:line and confidence
every deliverable item answered or marked unverifiable

result.summary:
Findings reported. Summary for the Planner:

**Deliverable 1 (role × section table, approx tokens):**
- `execute`: packet body capped 4800 chars (~1200 tok, spawn.py:195-366) + duplicated spec/acceptance/scope (~200-500 tok, execute.md:4-5) + execute.md instructions (~380 tok)
- `review`: spec/acceptance/scope/diff/gate, diff budget ≤8000 chars total (~2000 tok, spawn.py:426-505) + review.md (~150 tok)
- `spec_review`: spec/acceptance/scope/depends_on/tests, uncapped (spawn.py:508-524) + spec-review.md (~145 tok)
- `scout`: question/expected-output/scope-tree/memory-titles (spawn.py:527-546) + scout.md (~135 tok)
- headless `planner`: planner.md system prompt 4307B≈1077 tok (goals.py:342-345) + decision packet ≤6000 chars≈1500 tok (planner_packet.py:225-250)

**Deliverable 2 (byte-identical duplication — the core P1 measurement):** spec/acceptance/scope text is pulled from the same task fields independently by `_packet_body` (execute), `review_packet`, `spec_review_packet`, and `scout_packet` — no shared cache. Worse, inside the **execute prompt alone**, spec/acceptance/scope appear twice: once in `{{packet}}` (spawn.py:298-305) and again via execute.md's literal `Spec:/Acceptance:/Scope:` lines, confirmed at all 3 call sites (spawn.py:788, daemon.py:574,870).

**Deliverable 3 (tools/MCP):** worker roles get `.mcp.worker.json` (bus only) unless a role-specific override exists (`.mcp.scout.json`/`.mcp.review.json` add read-only github; `.mcp.planner.json` adds full github + orchestrator MCP). `--strict-mcp-config` blocks project/user auto-load.
